name: Nature’s Wrath (3rd Party – Total Party Kill Games)
body:
You have long combated the foes of the forest, and know how to hurt them.

Prerequisites: Briarborn

Benefit: You gain a +1 to attack and damage against creatures with the orc or goblin subtype.

Dwellers in Dream: The Briarborn. Copyright, January 27, 2013, Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian “Necroblivion” Berg, Richard “AWizardInDallas” Hunt
